addRecord((string,string,string,string,s.details: `keeper.AddRecord`. The chain sets `recordId`, `index`, `isLatest` and `timestamp`;      a checksum the registry already has gets a new version, not a new record.

addRegistry(string,string,string).details: `keeper.AddRegistry`. The creator is granted admin unchecked: nobody holds the role yet.

grantRole(uint64,string,address,string).details: `msgServer.GrantRole`. A checksum scopes the role to that record; either way the      registry's admin role administers it.

records(uint64,string,uint64,uint64,(byt.details: `queryServer.Records`: its five shapes, in its order. Record ids are `1..count`, so      a page skips by arithmetic rather than by walking.

registries(uint64,(bytes,uint64,uint64,b.details: `queryServer.Registries`, paged by `query.CollectionPaginate`: the one real cursor      (the next id, 8 bytes big-endian), and the one page that honours `reverse`.

revokeRole(uint64,string,address,string).details: `msgServer.RevokeRole`, with its checks in the module's order.

updateRecordStatus(uint64,uint64,uint64,.details: `keeper.UpdateRecordStatus`, checked against the stored checksum so a record role      reaches every version.

getRoleAdmin(bytes32).notice: Reverts for an unconfigured role, as `GetRoleAdmin` does, rather than returning zero.

registriesByName(string,uint8,(bytes,uin.notice: Exact match only: `matchMode` 0 or 1. Prefix (2), suffix (3) and contains (4)         were a node-local index; on chain they revert and stay an off-chain search.         The match folds ASCII case, as that index folded every name.
